```{r}
# STEP 1 - Raw Data Loading 

# 1.1 Load
listings <- read.csv("../data/raw/listings.csv")

# Output folder structure
root_out <- "../output"

dir_datainspect <- file.path(root_out, "datainspection")
dir_desc        <- file.path(root_out, "descriptive")
dir_desc_y      <- file.path(dir_desc, "Y_variables")
dir_desc_x      <- file.path(dir_desc, "X_variables")
dir_desc_xy     <- file.path(dir_desc, "XY_correlation")

dirs <- c(dir_datainspect, dir_desc, dir_desc_y, dir_desc_x, dir_desc_xy)

for (d in dirs) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# STEP 2 - Raw Data Inspection
# Always close any leftover sinks
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

# Save directly into output/datainspection
output_file <- file.path(dir_datainspect, "Raw_Data_Inspection.txt")

sink(output_file)

cat("====================================\n")
cat("RAW DATA INSPECTION\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

# 2.1 Inspect dimension
cat("2.1 Dataset Dimensions:\n")
print(dim(listings))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 2.2 Inspect column names
cat("2.2 Column Names:\n")
print(names(listings))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 2.3 Inspect data types
cat("2.3 Data Types:\n")
print(sapply(listings, class))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 2.4 Inspect missing values
cat("2.4 Missing Values (per column):\n")
print(colSums(is.na(listings)))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 2.5 Inspect duplicate rows
cat("2.5 Duplicate Rows:\n")
print(sum(duplicated(listings)))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

cat("END OF RAW DATA INSPECTION\n")
cat("====================================\n")

sink()

```

```{r}
# STEP 3 - Data Cleaning

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Select modeling variables
# -------------------------------------------------

df <- listings %>%
  select(
    id, host_id,
    price, extra_people, guests_included,
    room_type, accommodates, bedrooms, bathrooms, beds, property_type, amenities,
    neighbourhood_cleansed,
    latitude, longitude,
    host_is_superhost, host_response_time, host_response_rate, host_acceptance_rate,
    host_identity_verified, host_listings_count,
    minimum_nights, instant_bookable, cancellation_policy,
    review_scores_rating,
    number_of_reviews,
    host_since, last_scraped
  )

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.2 Convert variable values
# -------------------------------------------------

# 1) Monetary variables → numeric
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    price = as.numeric(str_remove_all(price, "[$,]")),
    extra_people = as.numeric(str_remove_all(extra_people, "[$,]"))
  )

# 2) Percentage variables → numeric
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    host_response_rate = str_trim(host_response_rate),
    host_acceptance_rate = str_trim(host_acceptance_rate),

    host_response_rate = ifelse(host_response_rate %in% c("N/A", "", "NA"),
                                NA, host_response_rate),
    host_acceptance_rate = ifelse(host_acceptance_rate %in% c("N/A", "", "NA"),
                                  NA, host_acceptance_rate),

    host_response_rate = as.numeric(str_remove(host_response_rate, "%")),
    host_acceptance_rate = as.numeric(str_remove(host_acceptance_rate, "%"))
  )

# 3) Structural numeric variables
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    guests_included = as.numeric(guests_included),
    accommodates = as.numeric(accommodates),
    bedrooms = as.numeric(bedrooms),
    bathrooms = as.numeric(bathrooms),
    host_listings_count = as.numeric(host_listings_count),
    minimum_nights = as.numeric(minimum_nights),
    review_scores_rating = as.numeric(review_scores_rating),
    number_of_reviews = as.numeric(number_of_reviews)
  )

# 4) Date variables
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    host_since  = as.Date(host_since),
    last_scraped = as.Date(last_scraped)
  )

# 5) Binary variables → 1/0
binary_map <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  ifelse(x %in% c("t", "yes", "true", "1"), 1,
         ifelse(x %in% c("f", "no", "false", "0"), 0, NA))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    host_is_superhost = binary_map(host_is_superhost),
    host_identity_verified = binary_map(host_identity_verified),
    instant_bookable = binary_map(instant_bookable)
  )

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3.3 Feature engineering
# -------------------------------------------------

# 3.3.1 Log price (keep only valid positive values)
df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(price) & price > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_price = log(price)) %>%
  select(-price)

# 3.3.2 Log host listings count
df <- df %>%
  mutate(log_host_listings_count = log(1 + host_listings_count)) %>%
  select(-host_listings_count)

# 3.3.3 Cap minimum_nights at 30
df <- df %>%
  mutate(minimum_nights = ifelse(minimum_nights > 30, 30, minimum_nights))

# 3.3.4 Amenities count
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    amenities_count = ifelse(
      is.na(amenities),
      0,
      str_count(amenities, '"') / 2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-amenities)

# 3.3.5 Host response time → ordinal scale
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    host_response_time = tolower(trimws(host_response_time)),
    host_response_time_ord = case_when(
      host_response_time == "within an hour" ~ 4,
      host_response_time == "within a few hours" ~ 3,
      host_response_time == "within a day" ~ 2,
      host_response_time == "a few days or more" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-host_response_time)

# 3.3.6 Distance to city center (Boston Common)
R <- 6371
lat2 <- 42.3550 * pi/180
lon2 <- -71.0656 * pi/180

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude),
    lat1 = latitude * pi/180,
    lon1 = longitude * pi/180,
    dlat = lat2 - lat1,
    dlon = lon2 - lon1,
    a = sin(dlat/2)^2 + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dlon/2)^2,
    distance_to_center_km = 2 * R * asin(sqrt(a))
  ) %>%
  select(-latitude, -longitude, -lat1, -lon1, -dlat, -dlon, -a)

# 3.3.7 Exposure (months_active) with guardrails
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    days_active = as.numeric(difftime(last_scraped, host_since, units = "days")),
    months_active = days_active / 30.44
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(host_since),
    !is.na(last_scraped),
    !is.na(months_active),
    is.finite(months_active),
    months_active >= 1
  )

# -------------------------------------------------
# Save cleaned dataset
# -------------------------------------------------

write.csv(df, "../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# STEP 4 - Clean Data Inspection

# 4.0 Reload cleaned dataset
df_clean <- read.csv("../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Always close any leftover sinks
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

# Save directly into output/datainspection
output_file <- file.path(dir_datainspect, "Clean_Data_Inspection.txt")
sink(output_file)

cat("====================================\n")
cat("CLEAN DATA INSPECTION\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

# 4.1 Dimensions
cat("4.1 Dataset Dimensions:\n")
print(dim(df_clean))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 4.2 Column names
cat("4.2 Column Names:\n")
print(names(df_clean))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 4.3 Data types
cat("4.3 Data Types:\n")
print(sapply(df_clean, class))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 4.4 Missing values
cat("4.4 Missing Values (count + %):\n")
missing_count <- colSums(is.na(df_clean))
missing_pct <- round((missing_count / nrow(df_clean)) * 100, 2)

missing_summary <- data.frame(
  missing_count = missing_count,
  missing_pct = missing_pct
)

# Show only columns with missing values
print(missing_summary[missing_summary$missing_count > 0, ])
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 4.5 Duplicated rows
cat("4.5 Duplicated Rows:\n")
print(sum(duplicated(df_clean)))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

# 4.6 Quick summaries (key variables for the project)
cat("4.6 Summary: number_of_reviews (Y)\n")
print(summary(df_clean$number_of_reviews))
cat("\n")

cat("4.6 Summary: months_active (exposure)\n")
print(summary(df_clean$months_active))
cat("\n")

cat("4.6 Summary: log_price\n")
print(summary(df_clean$log_price))
cat("\n")

cat("4.6 Summary: amenities_count\n")
print(summary(df_clean$amenities_count))
cat("\n------------------------------------\n\n")

cat("END OF CLEAN DATA INSPECTION\n")
cat("====================================\n")

sink()
```
